framings.text: A self-compounding meta harness that gives a human-first view across the entire agentic software development lifecycle, culminating in a rigorously verified PR for human review.

supports.quote: system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness
human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle
a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human

framings.text: A Michelin-star restaurant-like coordinating experience where the restaurateur remains the final judge, tasting work from brain dump through PR while preserving codebase health and making the next change easier.

supports.quote: it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt and I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product.
it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human

outcome: A human-first meta-harness experience spans the entire agentic software development lifecycle, from brain dump, prompt, hunch, and intuition to a PR ready for human review, where the restaurateur tastes the final product and sees codebase health preserved and the next change made easier.

questions.text: Should “compounds itself” mean the meta harness improves itself, the code base becomes easier to change, or both?
